moments.selftext: Mila Kunis is now 43 years old. She voiced Meg Griffin on Family Guy since she was just 15 years old. Mila Kunis has voiced Meg Griffin on Family Guy for more than 25 years. She landed the role in 1999 at just 15, taking over in the show’s second season after Lacey Chabert departed. Kunis essentially grew up alongside Meg, turning the character into one of the longest-running roles of her career while building a successful film career and becoming a major Hollywood star outside the series.

moments.selftext: Before filming Project X in 2012, the producers had the cast spend several weeks together to make their friendships “feel real on camera.” They took trips around Southern California and filmed themselves hanging out to help build their chemistry. The script was then adapted to match how the actors naturally joked and talked, while the characters were given the actors’ real names to make the movie feel like an authentic amateur film made by a group of actual friends.

moments.selftext: BREAKING: US interest expense on the national debt hit a record $1.4 trillion over the last 12 months. Since 2020, the cost of servicing US public debt has nearly TRIPLED. If rates remain stable, interest payments are set to rise to $1.7 trillion by November 2028. As a result, interest will surpass Social Security spending as the government's largest outlay for the first time. America's debt bill is spiraling out of control.
